finalPlanPrompt:
You are the VFX director for a production 2D side-scrolling Godot game.
Create exactly one production-feasible creative proposal. Return only JSON matching the supplied response schema.

Actor: shushi (character)
Skill id/name: 50319 / skill1
Optional user request: (none; infer a suitable effect from the skill, motion storyboard and project style)
Project style: 2D side-scrolling fantasy game VFX, clean silhouette, readable combat timing
Action: skill1, 4 frames at 7 fps
Frame size: 240x240
Foot center: (121, 230)
Allowed action events: [{"name":"release","frame":3}]
Allowed hit windows: [{"index":0,"start_frame":3,"end_frame":3,"forward":79,"y":-133,"width":20,"height":15}]
Allowed anchors: ["origin","foot","body_center"]
Current skill nodes are included and MUST influence the phase plan:
[
  {
    "type": "play_animation",
    "action": "skill1"
  },
  {
    "type": "wait_animation_end"
  },
  {
    "type": "end_skill"
  }
]

Rules:
- An action storyboard image is attached. Read the selected numbered poses, motion direction and silhouette before designing tracks.
- Use only these phases: charge, release, projectile, impact, area, attachment, buff, screen.
- Use only these trigger types: skill_start, action_event, hit_window_start, after_skill_node.
- Never invent an event, hit-window index, skill-node index, anchor or Buff id.
- For action_event, copy only the exact event name; never append a frame number or explanation.
- When no weapon/hand socket exists, use origin with an offset inferred from the storyboard and attack window.
- Do NOT create any impact track. Enemy-hit VFX are outside this workflow for normal skills; spend no tokens designing them.
- Add only phases justified by the action and user request; do not manufacture projectile or Buff stages.
- For every projectile_config, auto_calc_source must be exactly "alpha_bbox_median" and collision_shape exactly "rectangle".
- generation_prompt must be technical English for one isolated VFX layer and explicitly forbid characters, text, UI and scenery.
- library_query must be compact technical English suitable for semantic asset search.
- Use normal blend for smoke, leaves, soil and dark opaque effects; add/screen for energy, fire, lightning and glow.
- Keep the proposal production-feasible with 1-6 tracks. Proposal titles, summaries, track titles and descriptions must be Simplified Chinese.

proposals.title: 暗系魔导书释能技能特效
proposals.summary: 适配角色shushi持魔导书施法的4帧动作时序(7fps),表现蓄力阶段魔导书升腾紫焰、释放瞬间爆发闪光、向前发射暗紫魔法弹的战斗效果,特效剪影清晰,战斗时序明确,符合2D横版幻想游戏美术要求。
proposals.style: 2D横版卡通幻想风格,特效轮廓干净锐利,暗紫主色搭配高亮亮紫发光效果,战斗反馈直观,无冗余装饰元素

tracks.title: 暗紫魔法能量弹
